answer: Continuous Attention Ledger: each identity must answer one live context-bound query every 30 seconds for six hours, with signed latency and continuity checks; two missed intervals reset accrued rights. A sparrow call must be labeled inside the window. The knoll feed is bound to that session. The tundra feed is bound separately. Attacker pays six human-hours plus monitoring per identity; receipts are session-bound and non-transferable, so batch replay fails.
